title: Operationalising AI Regulatory Sandboxes: Activities, Requirements, and Technical Assessment under the EU AI Act
abstract: arXiv:2509.25256v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The systematic assessment of AI systems is increasingly vital as these technologies enter high-stakes domains. To address this, the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act introduces AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS): supervised environments where AI systems can be tested under the oversight of Competent Authorities (CAs), balancing innovation with compliance, particularly for startups and SMEs. Yet significant challenges remain: assessment methods are fragmented, tests lack standardisation, and feedback loops between developers and regulators are weak. This paper operationalises the AIRS lifecycle. translated_title: AI监管沙盒的可操作化：欧盟AI法案下的活动、需求与技术评估
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能技术进入高风险领域，对AI系统进行系统性评估变得日益重要。为此，欧盟《人工智能法案》引入了AI监管沙盒（AIRS）：这是一种受监督的环境，AI系统可以在主管机构的监督下进行测试，在创新与合规之间取得平衡，尤其有利于初创企业和中小企业。然而，仍然存在重大挑战：评估方法碎片化、测试缺乏标准化，以及开发者与监管者之间的反馈循环薄弱。本文对AIRS生命周期进行了可操作化。我们将沙盒流程映射为29项具体活动，涵盖从参与前指导，到申请、准备、参与、退出以及参与后监测的全过程，并区分了以监管监督为核心的核心AIRS（Core AIRS）以及在此基础上额外嵌入通过AI技术评估进行结构化技术测试的扩展AIRS（Extended AIRS）。
tldr: 本文将欧盟AI法案下的AI监管沙盒生命周期操作化为29项具体活动，并区分了以监管监督为核心的核心沙盒与嵌入结构化技术评估的扩展沙盒。
en_tdlr: This paper operationalises the AI Regulatory Sandbox lifecycle under the EU AI Act into 29 concrete activities, distinguishing a Core AIRS focused on regulatory oversight from an Extended AIRS that embeds structured technical assessment.
